title: ModelFlowStep
description: Canonical JSON contract for ModelFlowStep in jocaagura_domain.

indexNumber.description: Unique step index within the flow. Use -1 only as END target outside stored steps.

failureCode.description: Standardized failure code used for traceability.

nextOnSuccessIndex.description: Next step index when execution succeeds. Use -1 to represent END.

nextOnFailureIndex.description: Next step index when execution fails. Use -1 to represent END.

constraints.description: Ordered list of textual constraints applied to the step.

cost.description: Per-metric numeric costs expressed in real units.

examples.title: Authenticate
examples.description: Runs auth use case and returns Either result
